description: Mail one owned potion to a resident or member from gift_recipients. Use recipient (display name) and optional recipientRef. itemId accepts an owned potion ID or recipe ID from ingredient_catalog. Optional private note up to 500 characters. Postage 5 KARMABUX (owner exemption retained), both daily caps and gift permission apply. Residents receive immediately and keep thank-yous; other members claim from Mail and reply themselves. UUID requestId required.
name: gift_potion
